name: Notification Channel
description: A place alerts are delivered to. Today these are Microsoft Teams channels (each holds a Power Automate 'incoming webhook' URL). Create one row per Teams channel; Alert Types then pick which channel they post to.

fields.label: Channel Name
fields.description: A friendly name you choose, e.g. 'Safety Team', 'Battery Ops', 'Connectivity'. This is what you'll pick on an Alert Type.

fields.label: Type
fields.description: Where this delivers. Currently Microsoft Teams.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Uncheck to stop sending to this channel without deleting it.

fields.label: Default Channel
fields.description: Alerts whose Alert Type has no channel chosen will post here. Keep exactly one channel marked as default.

fields.label: Teams Webhook URL
fields.description: The Power Automate 'When a Teams webhook request is received' URL for this channel. Stored encrypted.

fields.label: Notes
fields.description: Optional: which Teams team/channel this points at, who owns it, etc.
